photo.name: porträtt, man, fotografi, photograph
photo.title: porträtt, man, fotografi, photograph
photo.reason: Studio-style documentary portrait of a Toucouleur man in traditional striped boubou robe and woven cap, holding a pipe, photographed in Ségou, French Sudan (Mali) in 1954 — a clear ethnographic dress photo matching the claimed group.

photo.name: porträtt, man, fotografi, photograph
photo.title: porträtt, man, fotografi, photograph
photo.reason: Portrait photograph of a man in Bandiagara, Mali, wearing a traditional striped robe (boubou), documented as Toucouleur Peul; this is a documentary photo of dress within the claimed culture's region.

architectural.name: hus, byggnad, fotografi, photograph
architectural.title: hus, byggnad, fotografi, photograph
architectural.reason: The photograph shows a mudbrick building (the "Stallet och Hotellet") in Bandiagara, French Sudan, with a Toucouleur man in traditional dress seated in the foreground; this documents Toucouleur architecture and daily life in their homeland.

architectural.name: byggnad, hus, fotografi, photograph
architectural.title: byggnad, hus, fotografi, photograph
architectural.reason: The image shows a close-up of Sudano-Sahelian mud-brick architecture (toron/wooden bundles projecting from banco walls, with triangular relief decoration), captioned as a Toucouleur stable/hotel building in Bandiagara, French Sudan (Mali) — this is the region and building tradition associated with the Toucouleur and neighboring Sahelian peoples, so it fits as plausible regional architecture.

textile.name: cloth; textile
textile.title: cloth; textile
textile.reason: A narrow-strip hand-woven cloth sewn from alternating patterned strips, consistent with West African (including Toucouleur/Senegambian) strip-weaving traditions; nothing contradicts the attribution.
